t: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said to Ghalib ibn Sa sa ah, the father of al-Farazdaq (the famous Arabic poet) during a conversation between them : What about the large number of your camels? The man replied : They have been swept away by (discharging of) obligations, O Amir al-Mu'minin! Whereupon Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said : That is the most praiseworthy way of (losing) them.
